title: Russell Reynolds Associates | Thirdway
description: Thirdway partners with owners, occupiers, and professional teams to create world-class spaces.

main: Occupying two levels of Almack House, Russell Reynolds Associates' newly designed workspace captures the unique character of both their client and office spaces.

Spanning 10,000 sq. ft over two floors, this project involved a tailored approach to workplace design. On Level 3,  a traditional CAT B design and interior fit-out for Russell Reynolds employees. While on Level 7, the CAT A & B fit-out aimed to refocus the space into a dedicated, versatile and sophisticated client suite.

To meet the diverse needs of the space Russell Reynolds required, our design process was rooted in a deep understanding of their business and how each floor would serve distinct functions. From the initial test fits through to the final delivery of the two floors in 2025, our approach carefully balanced the client’s aspirations with practical usability, resulting in two spaces that are not only visually striking but also highly functional and tailored to their purpose.

main: Taking inspiration from Almack House’s distinctive architecture, both floors have been designed to feel tailored, considered and refined, reflecting both the client and the prestige of its St James’s location. On the third floor, clean lines and premium materials create a sophisticated, timeless feel, while contemporary furniture adds a modern edge. The result is a space that respects the character of Almack House while feeling distinctly current and elegant.

Enhancing opportunities for collaboration across the third-floor space, the tea point and collaboration zone are placed at the entrance of the space. While making use of the arched feature window, this placement provides a welcoming arrival to the floor while encouraging interaction.

main: The seventh floor is dedicated to the client experience, with a focus on creating a best-in-class journey from the hospitality-inspired entrance through to the flexible collaboration and events space. A key feature is the engineered timber herringbone flooring, which flows continuously from reception through the event space, adding a sense of timeless elegance and reinforcing the premium character of the suite.

Reflecting Russell Reynolds Associates’ global presence, meeting rooms are named after international office locations, with small, considered styling details referencing each country. This subtle approach brings the wider global brand into the London workplace without feeling overly literal.
